title: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
title_zh: ScienceCUA：面向科学计算机使用智能体的资源到技能构建与执行引导的技能演化

paragraphs.en: ScienceCUA将科学软件文档转化为可复用技能，并通过执行反馈驱动技能自我演化提升任务成功率。 Computer-use agents for scientific software require application-specific expertise. Much of this expertise is documented in human-authored software manuals and web pages. However, turning these resources into executable, reusable skills remains challenging due to mismatches between documented and deployed software versions and differences in scope between documentation coverage and task requirements. We introduce ScienceCUA, a two-stage framework combining resource-to-skill construction with execution-guided skill evolution. First, ScienceCUA identifies tasks supported by the software from its documentation, infers operational trajectories, and generalizes them into reusable Skills. Command catalogs, syntax constraints, and shortcuts are organized separately as References for on-demand lookup. Then, ScienceCUA uses execution feedback to drive skill self-evolution by contrasting successful and failed trajectories for the same task, identifying deficiencies, revising existing skills or adding new ones, and updating the skill library only after repeated validation in real environments. To enable reliable evaluation without benchmark noise or task leakage, we introduce two improved benchmarks. ScienceBoard-Verified provides an audited and corrected basis for measuring task performance, while ScienceBoard-VE separates skill evolution from final testing through disjoint evolution and test tasks and further supports native-agent evaluation. Experiments show that the initial Skills and References improve average task success rate by up to 7.23 percentage points over the base model, while skill self-evolution increases the total gain over the baseline to as much as 17.12 percentage points. ScienceCUA turns software documentation into an evolving set of executable skills and queryable references, offering a practical way for general-purpose agents to use scientific software reliably and at scale.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceCUA将科学软件文档转化为可复用技能，并通过执行反馈驱动技能自我演化提升任务成功率。面向科学软件的计算机使用智能体需要应用特定的专业知识。 这些专业知识大多记录在由人工编写的软件手册和网页中。 然而，由于已文档化软件版本与实际部署软件版本之间的不匹配，以及文档覆盖范围与任务需求之间的范围差异，将这些资源转化为可执行、可复用的技能仍然充满挑战。 我们提出ScienceCUA，这是一个将资源到技能构建与执行引导的技能演化相结合的两阶段框架。 首先，ScienceCUA从软件文档中识别其所支持的任务，推断操作轨迹，并将其泛化为可复用的技能（Skills）。 命令目录、语法约束和快捷方式被单独组织为参考资料（References），以便按需查询。 然后，ScienceCUA利用执行反馈驱动技能自我演化，通过对比同一任务的成功轨迹与失败轨迹，识别不足之处，修订现有技能或添加新技能，并且只在真实环境中经过反复验证后才更新技能库。 为了在没有基准噪声和任务泄漏的情况下实现可靠评估，我们引入了两个改进的基准。 ScienceBoard-Verified提供了经过审核和修正的任务性能度量基础，而ScienceBoard-VE通过互不重叠的演化任务与测试任务将技能演化与最终测试分离，并进一步支持原生智能体评估。 实验表明，初始的技能与参考资料相比基座模型可将平均任务成功率提升多达7.23个百分点，而技能自我演化使相对基线的总增益达到高达17.12个百分点。 ScienceCUA将软件文档转化为不断演化的可执行技能集合与可查询参考资料，为通用智能体可靠且大规模地使用科学软件提供了一条实用途径。
